message: 寄り切りで押し倒し

name: Synn
message: 「It's been sunny every day since December started, hasn't it? We're definitely going to have great weather for this year's Holy Night Festival.」
Nanaka is walking slowly this morning too, her gaze cast slightly downward.
Up until just a little while ago, when we were eating breakfast together in my room, she had been laughing and having a great time. She probably heard about it from Misa.
Nanaka ended up teasing me mercilessly over my blunder in the library yesterday.

name: Nanaka
message: 「She's not here...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I can't even see her walking ahead of us.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Misa...」
Just as expected, Misa didn't show up at our usual meeting spot.
I walk alongside Nanaka, who is quieter than usual.
The things I find myself bringing up to her have become nothing but safe, trivial topics--the weather, bargains in the shopping district, and stuff like that.
Things had never been like this between us before.
From a window in the school building past the tree-lined avenue, Ria-senpai waves at us. In the end, we never caught sight of Misa. She must already be in her classroom.

name: Misa
message: 「Today is the day Lolotte-san and I are paired up, isn't it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, please go easy on me.」

name: Misa
message: 「We're just doing regular Student Council work. Onee-sama isn't here today either, so let's make sure we do a thorough job.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Being in the Student Council is fun because I get to meet all sorts of humans.」

name: Misa
message: 「...Lolotte-san, did you come to this world because you wanted to meet humans?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「As the saying goes, 'Nothing ventured into the tiger's den, nothing human.' To understand humans through firsthand experience, one really ought to live in the Human World.」

name: Misa
message: 「You got the saying wrong, though your point is right.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hauuh!? W-W-W-I'm not an angel, you know!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm back.」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Sakura-kun, you're back awfully early. Weren't you supposed to be doing Holy Night Festival surveys with Nanaka-san today?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, Nanaka breezed through them at blazing speed and headed straight over to the Sweets Club.」

name: Synn
message: 「She said that as club president, she needs to brainstorm their festival booth with Sacchin and the others. She's really working hard on everything.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I see」

name: Misa
message: 「...Even though they were alone together, nothing progressed...」

name: Misa
message: 「――N-No, stop it. I mustn't let my guard down!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, what's wrong?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Fufufu. I heard that, Madam Vice President」

name: Misa
message: 「L-Lolotte-san, shh! Shhhhhh!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I understand your desire to be alone with me, however――excuse me while I take my leave first♪」

name: Misa
message: 「Good work today... wait, why are you puffing your chest out like that?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I am about to head to the chairwoman's office on a vital mission. How thrilling, how suspenseful」

name: Synn
message: 「Did Helena-san summon you? If I remember right, Ria-senpai should be over there today too」

name: Misa
message: 「My sister has been assisting Helena-san day after day, yes, but... why would Lolotte-san be going there?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No. It seems the chairwoman actually has business with Grandpa, not me」

name: Synn
message: 「With Riesling-san? That makes even less sense. What could be going on?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Since Grandpa and the chairwoman are friends, perhaps she wants his advice on shopping for clothes or something similar?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If you ask me, now that autumn has ended, the chairwoman's figure has ended along with it. There is no doubt about it」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「『A trap awaits at the sweet gate』--an adage warning one to be careful during the season when food tastes delicious, you see」

name: Misa
message: 「The idiom is completely wrong, yet the underlying meaning is dead on」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well then, I shall leave the rest to the two of you--all aboard and off I go♪」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I don't overeat, you know? I'm perfectly capable of managing myself, thank you very much」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka eats sweets all the time, though I've never actually seen her dieting」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, a graceful swan is always paddling its feet furiously beneath the water」

name: Synn
message: 「You're talking about yourself, aren't you, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「Wh-wh-what!? Mmm-kiiiiiiiii!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「S-She's raging harder than I've ever seen before. Hurry up and apologize, Synn-sama」

name: Synn
message: 「B-But Misa's a hard worker, isn't she? She never works on writing lyrics during Student Council hours」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sure she draws a clear line and fulfills her duties as choir leader late into the night after going home」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh... so that's what you meant」

name: Synn
message: 「What did you think I meant?」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-That was... Hmph!」

name: Paqy
message: 「His timing was the worst, but Synn-sama was praising you, Hiss」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-Thanks...」

name: Misa
message: 「You're giving me too much credit, though. Even during Student Council activities, I write lyrics whenever I have a free moment」

name: Misa
message: 「Still... haaah~. I haven't made much progress」
Letting out a sigh, Misa takes a notebook out of her bag.

name: Misa
message: 「Look, the cover is all worn out, yet the actual pages inside are practically brand new」

name: Synn
message: 「You carry it around with you all the time, huh」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes. So I can jot down lyrics whenever they come to mind, no matter when or where」

name: Misa
message: 「I know it's not something you can just force yourself to write, but... without some kind of theme, it really is difficult」

name: Synn
message: 「Since everyone will be singing it together, something fun would be nice, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「How to make it fun. That's the theme」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, there's barely over two weeks left... I wonder if it'll be okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「You can write great prose, can't you, Misa? You'll be fine」

name: Misa
message: 「Poems and novels are meant to be read with the eyes, but songs are meant to be heard with the ears, you know?」

name: Misa
message: 「No matter how pretty the writing is, there are times when it doesn't come across at all once you actually vocalize and pronounce the words...」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, that means you've got the fundamentals down perfectly. If it's you, Misa, I'm sure you'll turn it into a wonderful song!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun...」

name: Misa
message: 「O-Of course I'll make it a great song! I don't need the likes of you telling me that!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I'm really not being much help, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I might be able to help out with specifics, so let me see what you have so far」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh...? W-Well, that's, um...」

name: Misa
message: 「No」

name: Synn
message: 「Why not? Saying you haven't made much progress means you've written at least a little, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「No means no. I'm not showing it to you, Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「No need to be shy--everyone's going to hear it at the Holy Night Festival anyway」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I-I-I'm not being shy or anything!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then let me see」

name: Misa
message: 「No way」

name: Synn
message: 「Let me see, let me see, let me see!」

name: Misa
message: 「No way, no way, no way!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You don't have to run away」

name: Misa
message: 「I will protect this notebook with all my heart and soul, with pride and dignity」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm gonna catch you!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huff, huff, huff... Y-You're fast」

name: Misa
message: 「As if I'd ever get caught by someone like you, Sakura-kun, when you couldn't even keep up with me on a dark street」

name: Synn
message: 「That was a draw because you hid in a back alley, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「Then let's continue our match」

name: Synn
message: 「Bring it on!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold it right there!」

name: Misa
message: 「As if I would!」
The two of us dash around and around the Student Council room.

name: Synn
message: 「Huff, huff...」

name: Misa
message: 「Huff, phew... You're out of breath, Sakura-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Right back at you, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「I am not!」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm going to protect this notebook no matter what!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Whoa there, you ain't getting past here!」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh!?」
Suddenly, Paqy leaps out in front of Misa.

name: Paqy
message: 「Lord Synn! Now's your chance--」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyaah!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Pimugyu!」
Stepping right on Paqy, Misa trips forward.

name: Misa
message: 「I'm so sorry, Paqy-san!!」

name: Synn
message: 「W―Whoa! If you stop all of a sudden―」
Carried by my momentum, I collide straight into Misa.
Tangled up together, we crash-land onto the sofa.

name: Synn
message: 「M-Misa...」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Sakura... -kun...」
Pinned beneath me, her body--so much more slender and delicate than how she usually carries herself--trembles slightly.

name: Misa
message: 「D-Don't just go quiet... Say something...」

name: Synn
message: 「S-S-Sorr--」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't apologize!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't want you... to apologize...」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah」

name: Misa
message: 「I really... don't want you to... okay」
I need to back off right now. I have to let Misa go.
Even though I know that in my head, I can't move a muscle, and end up locking eyes with Misa.
My heart is pounding. I'm a nervous wreck. Can Misa hear my heartbeat?

name: Misa
message: 「W-Why do you... always...」

name: Misa
message: 「Stop confusing me...! J-Just when I finally...!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Good day to you. Pardon the intrusion」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Is Ria around? About those sweet potato and candy confections from the other day--」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh my. You two, while it's still bright outside--」

name: Misa
message: 「M-M-M-Misasagi-senpai, you've got it wrong, this is--」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heehee, how precocious. Don't you worry, I'll keep it a secret from everyone, alright?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's not like that...!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Still, Mr. Vice President, weren't you supposed to be pining after Ria?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, no matter. If you're switching your ride over to Madam President, I'm all for it」

name: Misa
message: 「Please don't say 'switching your ride'!!」

name: Synn
message: 「She's right, I'm the one currently on top of Misa, aren't I!」

name: Misa
message: 「What are you saying, you idiot!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well then, do take your time」

name: Synn
message: 「N... No, no, sorry we couldn't be better hosts...」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, why are you seeing her off! She left before we could clear up the misunderstanding!」

name: Synn
message: 「I―It'll be fine! Besides―」
A misunderstanding... huh. I couldn't help thinking that I wished it wasn't one.

name: Misa
message: 「W-What is it……」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, this was just an accident, so…… I thought it'd be fine」

name: Misa
message: 「R-Right……」
I sit up from the sofa and help Misa to her feet.

name: Synn
message: 「……Let's get back to our Student Council duties」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-Yeah」
